From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clevercart.io>
Date: 2026-10-01 09:12 PDT
Subject: Intro + quick qualification for Redwood demo and scheduling

Hi Samira —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I’m Sofia on the SDR team — excited to get a short demo scheduled and make sure we tailor it to what CleverCart needs. Before we lock a time, two quick things so the demo is useful for your team:

- Primary use case: product search reranking / semantic matching? Any specific flows (search, recommendations, chat)?
- Traffic: rough daily request volume or tokens/day (ballpark is fine), and expected peak concurrency.
- Timeline: are you aiming for a pilot in 4–8 weeks, or later this quarter?
- Security/residency: do you need SOC2 / private deployment / specific region?
- Demo attendees: will you bring engineers or product folks?

If you can reply with the bullets above I’ll propose a couple of 30-minute slots. If it’s easier, here’s my booking link: https://cal.redwood.com/booking/sofia/30m

Thanks — talk soon,
Sofia Ivanova
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

P.S. If you already have a sample traffic csv or a short doc with QPS and payload shapes, feel free to attach it and we’ll build the demo around it.

From: Samira Khan <samira@clevercart.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Intro + quick qualification for Redwood demo and scheduling

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick reach out. Quick answers below — happy to expand in the demo.

- Primary use case: reranking product search results using embeddings + lightweight generation for enriched snippets. We also experiment with recommendations but search rerank is highest priority.
- Traffic: today ~2.5M queries/month (~75k/day). Average payload ~120 tokens; peak QPS observed during drops ~110 QPS (approx).
- Timeline: aiming to run a pilot in ~6 weeks; need to validate latency at 95th percentile and cost per 1M tokens.
- Security/residency: SOC2 required; we prefer US data residency but open to discussion for Dedicated.
- Attendees: me (PM) + 2 engineers from our backend team (I’ll loop them in).

I’ve attached a one-week sample traffic CSV (sample_traffic_week.csv) with timestamps and query sizes — anonymized. For scheduling, next Wed (Oct 6) or Thu (Oct 7) mornings PDT work for us.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Product Manager, CleverCart
samira@clevercart.io

Hi Samira — thanks for the details and for attaching the sample. Ben here (AE) — looping in to run the demo and cover pilot next steps. A few follow-ups so we can tailor the session and bring the right people: 

1) Model / accuracy preferences: are you evaluating open models (Llama-family, Falcon) or a hosted baseline? Any preference for quantized variants?
2) Auth / SSO: do you require SAML/Okta for demo access or only for production?
3) Pilot success criteria: top-line priorities (latency at p95, throughput, token cost, relevance metrics). If you have an SLA target number for p95 latency, please share.
4) Integration: do you need assistance with a light SDK PoC or will your engineers handle it?

Proposed demo slots (30m):
- Wed Oct 6, 10:00–10:30 PDT
- Wed Oct 6, 15:00–15:30 PDT
- Thu Oct 7, 09:00–09:30 PDT

If none of those work, here’s my booking link: https://cal.redwood.com/booking/ben/30m

I’ve also attached a short one-pager of demo templates so you can pick a structure (redwood-demo-templates.pdf).

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda: 1) quick infra/requirements check (5m), 2) tailored demo using a sanitized subset of your sample traffic (15m), 3) next steps and pilot options (10m).

Thanks — cc’ing Sofia to keep continuity.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Hi Ben / Sofia —

Thanks — Wed Oct 6 at 10:00 PDT works for our group. Confirming: me + two backend engineers (I’ve cc’d eng@clevercart.io so they have the invite). A few answers to your follow-ups:

1) Model preferences: open models are fine for evaluation (we prefer to avoid managed black-box models right now). Quantized FP16 variants are fine if they preserve recall.
2) SSO: SAML/Okta required for production; demo can use temporary accounts.
3) Success criteria: p95 latency <= 200ms for the short payloads; target throughput to handle 120 QPS with acceptable latency. Cost: we’ll use your recommendation for a 30-day cost projection.
4) Integration: engineers will run the SDK PoC but would appreciate a skeleton repo or example ingestion script.

I’ll expect the calendar invite. Looking forward — appreciate the fast turnaround.
